description: Frontend screens: replace the FEAT-003 placeholders with the full Vue 3 Options-API SFCs — MyCourts (owner list), CourtForm (create/edit, mirroring TeamForm), CourtShow (read-only detail with WhatsApp button), and AdminCourtList (approval screen mirroring AdminTeamList). pt-BR, dark mode, Tailwind orange accent, axios singleton. Depends on FEAT-003 (router/nav/placeholders) and FEAT-002 (API contract).
steps: Replace src/views/System/Court/MyCourts.vue: wrap in <system-layout>; fetch api.get('/court/my-courts') on created/mounted into courts (response shape { courts: [...] }); render rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 cards with the cover photo (photos[] item with position 0, field photo_url), name, modality_info.name, city_info.name + city_info.state_info.name, and a status badge (pending=amber 'Pendente', approved=green 'Aprovada', rejected=red 'Rejeitada'). Each card links to { name:'court-show', params:{ id } } and has an edit link to { name:'court-edit', params:{ id } }. Empty state: 'Você ainda não tem quadras. Cadastre a primeira.' with a button to { name:'court-form' }. Show a loading spinner like other screens.

Replace src/views/System/Court/CourtForm.vue following /home/andrefontoura/PhpstormProjects/sisbrasfute_tailwind/src/views/System/Team/TeamForm.vue (isEditMode computed from route param id, FormData submit with multipart/form-data, Swal error toast rendering Object.values(data.errors).flat()). Sections: (1) Informações básicas — courtName input, courtDescription via QuillEditor, modality via <ModalitiesSelect v-model="selectedModalities" label-name="Modalidade" /> (bind an array in data(); on submit append a SINGLE scalar formData.append('courtModalityId', this.selectedModalities[0] ?? '')), state via <StateSelect v-model="stateId" /> + city via <CitySelect :state-id="stateId" v-model="form.courtCityId" />, surface <select> with the 4 enum options (value natural/sintetico/emborrachado/piso), courtAddressLine input. (2) Contatos — dynamic rows (add/remove) each with a type <select> (whatsapp/phone/other) + value input + optional label; append as contacts[i][type|value|label]. (3) Fotos — multiple file input with preview thumbnails and remove; enforce 1..10 client-side (disable add at 10) with server as source of truth; on edit, existing photos render with a remove ✕ that pushes the id into removedPhotoIds[]; append new files as photos[] and removedPhotoIds[] as removedPhotoIds[i]. (4) Configuração de horários — 7 weekday rows (Dom..Sáb, weekday 0..6) each with an isActive toggle, startTime + endTime <input type="time">, and a reservationDuration <select> (60/90/120 labelled 1h/1h30/2h); append as scheduleConfigs[i][weekday|startTime|endTime|reservationDuration|isActive]. (5) Regras de preço — dynamic rows each with weekday <select> + startTime + endTime + a BRL price input converted to priceCents (integer centavos); append as pricingRules[i][weekday|startTime|endTime|priceCents]. POST to '/court/save' (create) or '/court/update/'+id (edit); in edit mode first GET '/court/show/'+id and prefill all sections. On success router.push({ name:'my-courts' }).

Replace src/views/System/Court/CourtShow.vue: read-only owner detail fetched from api.get('/court/show/'+id). Photo gallery/carousel reusing the markup pattern from src/views/System/Team/TeamShow.vue; info cards (orange-accent icon tiles) for modality_info, surface_type (map enum value to label), city/state, address_line; a contacts list where type==='whatsapp' renders an anchor to `https://wa.me/` + value.replace(/\D/g,'') (strip non-digits) and phone/other render as text (phone as tel:); read-only tables for pricing_rules (weekday + time range + R$ formatted from price_cents) and schedule_configs (weekday + window + duration + active). Status badge as in MyCourts.

Replace src/views/System/Admin/AdminCourtList.vue mirroring /home/andrefontoura/PhpstormProjects/sisbrasfute_tailwind/src/views/System/Admin/AdminTeamList.vue: a filter card with a status <select> defaulting to 'pending' (options Pendentes/Aprovadas/Rejeitadas) plus StateSelect/CitySelect/modality; a table (name, owner name, modality, city, status badge, photo count); per-row Aprovar and Rejeitar actions. Reject opens a modal (same modal style used elsewhere) with an optional reason textarea then POST '/admin/courts/'+id+'/reject' { reason }; Approve POSTs '/admin/courts/'+id+'/approve'. Fetch via api.get('/admin/courts', { params: { status, modality_id, state_id, city_id } }) and refetch after each action. Handle the Laravel paginator response shape (data[] etc.).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` succeeds with all four full SFCs in place (no placeholder content remains).

CourtForm builds a FormData with courtModalityId as a single scalar (not an array), contacts[]/pricingRules[]/scheduleConfigs[] indexed keys, photos[] files, and removedPhotoIds[] on edit; posts multipart/form-data to /court/save or /court/update/:id.
CourtShow renders a WhatsApp button linking to https://wa.me/<digits-only> for whatsapp contacts.
AdminCourtList defaults the status filter to pending and wires Aprovar/Rejeitar to the admin endpoints, refetching after actions.
MyCourts renders the owner's courts with status badges and an empty state linking to the create form.
verification: Run `npm run build` from /home/andrefontoura/PhpstormProjects/sisbrasfute_tailwind and confirm it completes without errors.
Optionally run `npm run lint` and confirm no new errors.
findings: COMPLETED. All four FEAT-003 placeholder SFCs replaced with full implementations in the FRONTEND repo (sisbrasfute_tailwind). `npm run build` passes; `npm run lint` is clean for all four Court SFCs (the only remaining lint errors are pre-existing in unrelated files). SFCs delivered: - src/views/System/Court/MyCourts.vue: GET /court/my-courts -> { courts }, cover photo = photos[] item with position 0 (field photo_url, fallback to [0]), name, modality_info.name, city_info.name + city_info.state_info.name, status badge (pending=amber Pendente / approved=green Aprovada / rejected=red Rejeitada). Cards link to court-show and court-edit; empty-state links to court-form; loading spinner. - src/views/System/Court/CourtForm.vue: mirrors TeamForm (isEditMode from route param id, multipart FormData, Swal error flatten via Object.values(data.errors).flat()). ModalitiesSelect v-model=selectedModalities (array) appended as a SINGLE scalar formData.append('courtModalityId', this.selectedModalities[0] ?? ''). StateSelect + CitySelect(:state-id). Surface defaults to 'pending' (Pendentes/Aprovadas/Rejeitadas) + StateSelect/CitySelect/modality filters. Table: name, owner.name, modality_info.name, city/state, status badge, photos_count. GET /admin/courts with params {page, per_page:15, status, modality_id, state_id, city_id}; handles LengthAwarePaginator (response.data.data + pagination meta via PaginationComponent). Aprovar -> POST /admin/courts/:id/approve; Rejeitar opens a modal with optional reason textarea (<=1000) -> POST /admin/courts/:id/reject { reason: value || null }; refetches current page after each action. PRE-EXISTING BLOCKERS resolved to let the build gate pass (both unrelated to FEAT-004, confirmed present on origin/main HEAD): 1. vue-advanced-cropper 2.8.9 was declared in package.json but not installed in node_modules (ImageCropUpload.vue import failed). Fixed by running `npm install` (no package.json/lockfile change). 2. src/views/System/Team/TeamShow.vue had an orphaned extra (Invalid end tag ~line 444) that failed the whole Vue compile. Removed the single orphaned tag (behavior-neutral) with parent approval; committed separately as 'fix: remove orphaned closing div in TeamShow (pre-existing broken end tag blocking build)'. COMMITS (local, branch main, NOT pushed): c36481f (TeamShow end-tag fix, 1 file) and 020a69e 'feat: court frontend screens (FEAT-004)' (4 Court SFCs). Note: dist/ artifact changes and a stray php8.5-xml .deb in the FRONTEND working tree were intentionally left unstaged.
